notes: Corrected: the five ofs before Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik and Rehob had been given to those place names under rule 33. That rule reaches a nominal standing with no preposition and no object marker on it, and each of these names carries אֵת, so its condition is unmet; its own subtraction test also fails, since dropping the of leaves each name with exactly the direct-object relation the Hebrew gives it and what has gone is the head noun the ASV supplied for the earlier members and then gapped. Each of is now its own `added` unit and each marker remains `unrepresented`.
The first two members keep their ofs on the written recta of יֹשְׁבֵי עַכּוֹ and יֹשְׁבֵי צִידוֹן under rule 19; only the members where the participle is gapped are affected.

The competing reading gives the word to the marker on the analogy of rule 16's demoted-role-phrase family; that was rejected because the of does not state the object relation but the relation to a head noun the Hebrew never writes, so none of rule 16's four families reaches it.
Partition after correction: all 25 source and 28 target IDs are used exactly once.
